messages:
sam: Quick stitch-up on postmortem follow-ups — we need final owners and a clear timeline for customer-facing bits (status page text, concise incident summary, and who gets the RCA access request).
elaine: I can take the status page copy. Will draft a short neutral paragraph + blameless explanation. target: EOD Thursday.
raj: I'll own remediation tracking sheet and recurring-pattern notes. I'll add the next three recurrence candidates and link to graphs. ETA: Tuesday morning.
maria: For RCA sharing policy, we should be explicit: internal RCA + timeline summary public, full RCA on request with NDAs for enterprise. I'll pull legal-approved wording.
sam: Sounds good. Oliver, can you coordinate customer outreach for named accounts that got impacted? Need to confirm whether we send tailored notes or rely on status page + 1:1.
oliver: I can do that. Suggest targeted 1:1 for top 5 and a broadcast for the rest. Will standby until status copy is ready so tone matches.
elaine: Draft status page snippet (WIP):
```
Incident: intermittent inference errors affecting a subset of requests.
Impact: delayed or failed responses for some customers between 10:03–10:47 UTC.
Status: mitigated; full service restored.
Next steps: ongoing investigation; we will publish an RCA and any remediation steps within 7 business days.
```
raj: I like that. Two suggestions: change "subset of requests" -> "subset of customers" and add a line about rollback/fallback used.
elaine: updated: added fallback sentence and swapped wording.
comms-bot: @channel Draft status page posted to #incidents-drafts for review: https://intranet/redwood/status-drafts/1975312000
maria: On RCA sharing: proposed rule — public incident summary + 7-business-day RCA window; full internal RCA available to customers on request if they sign the data-sharing addendum. Any objections?
sam: No objections. Make sure request flow is simple: customer emails support@, support flags to psa-team, we triage. Add that to the postmortem checklist.
raj: I've added a row to the remediation tracker: "KV cache fix plan" owner: @raj, due 2026-04-09, verification: 2-week regression eval. Also added a recurring pattern note: similar latency spikes on median within 30d window -> investigate batching heuristics.
oliver: For outreach cadence: plan a short apology + impact + mitigation + link to status page + offer to review RCA on request. Draft for top accounts by Thursday AM.
elaine: Who's running the 72-hour summary? I can do that as a shorter digest to customers as pre-RCA communication.
maria: Elaine do the 72h; Sam you'll approve before send.
sam: Yep. Approve workflow: Elaine -> Sam -> Comms -> Send.
comms-bot: Reminder set: statuspage copy review due in 36 hours.
raj: One more: can we automate routine recurrence detection? I'll prototype a weekly job that flags similar stack traces and latency windows, output to #eng-runtime.
maria: Good, add that to Optimize backlog. Also, please tag any customer-impacting findings so comms can prepare proactive messaging templates.
oliver: I'll wait for the status copy then draft the customer note templates.
elaine: Action list summary: 1) Status page copy - owner: elaine - EOD Thu. 2) 72h summary - owner: elaine - ready Fri AM for Sam review. 3) Remediation tracker entry + pattern notes - owner: raj - Tue AM. 4) RCA sharing wording - owner: maria - Wed EOB. 5) Top-5 outreach drafts - owner: oliver - Thu AM. 6) Automation prototype for recurrence detection - owner: raj - spike by next sprint planning.
sam: Thanks all. Please update the tracker and ping me once your task is uploaded. We'll close this stitch-up once all customer-facing copy is in staging and the outreach drafts exist.
raj: Uploaded remediation tracker link: https://drive.redwood/trackers/remediation-1975312000
elaine: Draft posted to drafts channel. @sam waiting for review.
maria: Legal approved the RCA sharing language with minor edit; added to the doc.
comms-bot: Task reminders created for owners and due-dates.
